method.screening_view: Dense source-video review followed by the exact ordered eight-frame packet delivered by the benchmark
method.admission_boundary: Passing rows are video-screened constructions only. They still require two independent construction reviews, a frozen 16-item catalog, deterministic checker tests, independent human validation, evaluator replay, and protocol-valid real-model runs.
method.primary_analysis_independence: The nine passing Ego2Web expansion rows use nine distinct source videos. Source-cluster independence must be checked again after the two HD-EPIC additions and three seed tasks are combined into the complete 14-task Clarify selection.

explicit_rejections.reason: Camera motion makes immediate left/right adjacency around the Heinz anchor unstable.
Food contents distinguish the interaction roles, but the pans themselves do not map to different catalog products.
The exact packet does not support a repeatable image-only judgment that exactly two vegetables were cut.
The second scissors-like form is occluded and the proposed handle-color distinction is not grounded.

rejected_source_patterns.reason: More than two products satisfy the proposed wording or the left/right relation changes during camera motion.
Removing a visible attribute leaves only one candidate and therefore creates no real need to clarify.
